Kerala High Court Upholds Woman's Right to Personal Dress Choice

The Kerala High Court has affirmed a woman's right to choose her attire, stating that dress is a personal choice. In a related but distinct ruling, the court also stated that hitting a woman's chest with an elbow does not, in itself, demonstrate an intent to outrage her modesty, reversing a prior decision on this specific point.
